datasets.title: Whole blood transcriptomics data in normal pregnancy, preterm birth and early preeclampsia
datasets.summary: This SuperSeries is composed of the SubSeries listed below.
datasets.study_design: 孕妇外周血样本，表达谱芯片检测，比较正常妊娠、早产、胎膜早破及早发型子痫前期。
datasets.relevance_reason: 数据集包含PPROM（早产胎膜早破）患者的全血转录组数据。

evidence.relevant: 包含189例PPROM（早产胎膜早破）独立分组，作为目标疾病的明确研究主体，满足主体轴与样本轴。
evidence.sequencing_type: Expression profiling by array; total RNA from whole blood; CEL files with RMA normalization to ENTREZ IDs → typical mRNA microarray. No evidence of specific ncRNA enrichment.
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级元数据仅有诊断分组、孕周等，缺乏生存时间与状态字段，无法进行患者生存分析。
evidence.treatment: 样本分组为正常对照和不同疾病状态（PPROM等），无药物治疗与对照的比较轴。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: group字段明确分为Control(314例正常妊娠)与PPROM(189例早产胎膜早破)，均为独立健康孕妇对照，平台为表达芯片(mRNA microarray)，样本量充足，符合三关要求。
evidence.correlation: mRNA microarray表达芯片；PPROM组189个全血临床样本，独立患者数>15
evidence.sample_source: 所有735个样本的source字段均为'Whole blood'，采集后直接存入PAXgene RNA管，未进行细胞分选或体外培养，属于外周血直接组分，因此归类为blood。

datasets.title: Inflammation and senescence-related microRNAs from circulating small extracellular vesicles are altered in women undergoing preterm birth.
datasets.summary: Preterm labor (PTL) and preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) lead to severe perinatal morbidity/mortality worldwide. Small extracellular vesicles (sEV) act in cell communication and contain microRNAs that are potential biomarkers for these complications. We aimed to compare the expression, in sEV from peripheral blood, of miRNAs between term and preterm pregnancies.
datasets.overall_design: Case-control study with women with PTL, PPROM, term pregnancy with and without labor, seen at the Botucatu Medical School Hospital, SP, Brazil. sEV were isolated from plasma. Western blot for detection of exosomal protein CD63 and Nanoparticle Tracking Analysis were performed. The expression of 800 miRNAs was assessed by nCounter Humanv3 miRNA Assay (NanoString). Comparison of miRNAs expression and relative risk was performed.

datasets.title: mRNA expression  profiles in human cervix at preterm delivery, delivery after preterm premature rupture of membranes and term delivery
datasets.summary: Objective: Mechanisms of preterm labour (PTL) are not fully elucidated. Cervical ripening plays an important role. We aimed to investigate possible differences in gene expression in human cervix between PTL and term labour (TL) and between PTL and preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM).
datasets.overall_design: Cervical biopsies were obtained from women immediately postpartum (within 30 minutes). The biopsies were taken transvaginally with scissors and tweezers at twelve o'clock position. There were 3 women in each group (preterm labor, preterm premature rupture of membranes and term labor) included.
datasets.study_design: 产后宫颈组织，PPROM、早产和足月产妇各3例，表达芯片比较基因表达。
datasets.relevance_reason: 包含胎膜早破(PPROM)产妇的宫颈组织样本。

evidence.relevant: 标题与摘要以PPROM为研究主体之一，3例宫颈样本明确取自PPROM患者，直接研究该病宫颈表达机制。
evidence.sequencing_type: GEO数据类型为Expression profiling by array，样本总RNA Trizol提取，CEL格式并用Plier分析，标题明示mRNA表达谱，机制指向mRNA microarray。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本量9例，无生存时间或状态字段，无法做生存分析。
evidence.treatment: 分组为分娩类型(PPROM/PTL/TL)，无药物干预对照轴。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 表达芯片平台；delivery字段含PPROM(3例)与term delivery(3例)，后者可作为无胎膜早破的正常对照。
evidence.correlation: 疾病样本仅6例(PPROM+PTL)，不满足>15要求，无法做表达相关性分析。
evidence.sample_source: 全部9个样本均为产后宫颈活检组织，未分选特定细胞、未经体外培养，直接浸RNAlater后提取RNA测序，属整块实体组织。
